structured_output.what_is_happening: About 14 minutes after launch, the Franklin The Turtle copy with the most trading volume just graduated from pump.fun to PumpSwap. It was created about 13:06 UTC and migrated about 13:13, taking roughly 6.5 minutes. More than 10 other same-name coins launched within the same few minutes, which points to a fresh trigger for the Franklin meme. The price peaked at 9.39e-5 and has fallen about 46% to 5.04e-5, though it bounced about 41% in the last 5 minutes. Volume is about $200k against a $50k market cap. The creator wallet has launched 912 tokens. GMGN flags 280 bundler wallets and 271 fresh wallets, and trading fees go to @maverickdarby via UsePaid.

narrative.description: Franklin the Turtle is a known meme that already ran in late 2025. A burst of copies launched within minutes of each other suggests a new viral moment: the linked X post from LevanInSolana, with fees sent to @maverickdarby.
narrative.why_spreading: A familiar meme brought back by a new post. Many launchers are racing each other, which shows the attention is real, but it is split across many tickers.

token_connection.why_this_token: It was the first of this cluster to migrate and has by far the most volume (about $200k/h). It links an X post and routes fees to a named account through UsePaid.
token_connection.competing_tokens: EP1FL…ABAGS migrated 3.6 minutes later and sits at a $60k market cap with only $2.4k/h volume. Many copies are still on the bonding curve (BsDUQ… $15k/h, 5PdWi…, J7eyy…). There is also an older CSrwN… pump token from 2025.

authenticity.evidence: About 967 unique buyers and 834 unique sellers in 15 minutes is real breadth. Against that: 280 bundler wallets, 271 fresh wallets, a 53% bot/degen rate, 41 snipers, and a serial dev with 912 launches. On the positive side, there are no paid DexScreener boosts and 23 smart wallets.
authenticity.uncertainty: Without X data I cannot see how big the underlying viral post is, or whether one Franklin coin is being named as the canonical one.

structural_risks: The creator has launched 912 tokens, so this is a factory launch
Bundlers hold about 23% of top holders and snipers about 20%
Liquidity of about $18.7k is thin; the LP is burned, but supply can still be dumped into it
The price has already fallen about 46% from its high
Attention is split across competing copies

structured_output.counterargument: Franklin is a proven meme that has reached multi-million market caps before. This coin leads its cluster on volume, was first to migrate, and has broad participation with smart wallets present. If the X post keeps spreading, the leading copy could re-test $94k and push on toward $100k–$150k, which is 2x from here.
unknowns: How big and how fast the triggering X post is spreading
Whether any KOL or community will pick a different copy as the canonical Franklin
When the bundlers and snipers plan to sell

structured_output.thesis: This is the most-traded copy in a real Franklin revival, with genuine buyer breadth. The downsides are a factory dev, heavy bundling and sniping, a price already down about 46% from its high, and many competing copies. It has an above-average shot at a 2x, but the most likely path is fading chop.
